Personality: Mithradukht, a prominent figure of the Priests of Komana, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Mithradukht owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Cappadocia, hailing from the noble house of Priests of Komana. Historical Record: Wife of Mithraas, head of the Priests of Komana, an Anatolian house of Cappadocia. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
